PROOF thm cm_concrete_code_ready_def = new_fun_definition(
    `cm_concrete_code_ready (p:cm_program) : bool =
       (cm_concrete_structs_ready p &&
        cm_concrete_functions_ready p 0i (cm_program_functions p))`);
